lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\ReMarkableConnector\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

places: GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/app_template/api: in openapi.json, and no route provides it
lines: The OpenAPI specification and the routes differ in 2 operations. A client generated from the specification then calls what is not there, or lacks what is. This holds the routes against the specification and does not generate it again.
GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/app_template/api: in openapi.json, and no route provides it
Nothing in the app calls 1 OCS route. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
